earliest_visible_sign.description: Pale green to yellow chlorotic streaks on young leaves, chlorotic mottling or narrow longitudinal stripes
earliest_visible_sign.location_on_plant: young leaves, leaves of young seedlings

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: Long chlorotic stripes running parallel to leaf veins with white-grey downy growth on the lower leaf surface

colors.color_progression: Pale green to yellow stripes, turning yellow-brown, reddish-brown, or necrotic dark brown

shape.shape_progression: Narrow streaks widen, merge, and form blotches

size.size_variation_note: Stripe size varies; systemic infection can lead to narrow, erect leaves

texture_and_surface.sporulation_or_sign: White, grey-white, or downy growth on the lower leaf surface, especially during humid nights or mornings
texture_and_surface.other_surface_details: Leaves become narrow, erect, pale, and sometimes shredded

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Chlorotic leaves turn yellow-brown, reddish-brown, or necrotic; plants become stunted with malformed reproductive parts
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: Yellow stripes widen, merge, and form blotches, leading to leaf shredding
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: Leaves may dry, shred, or die prematurely
secondary_signs: malformed tassels with leafy proliferation (crazy top)
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Systemic infection can affect the whole plant, potentially killing seedlings or entire plants before flowering

distribution_on_plant.vertical_pattern: Systemic infection affecting leaves, tassels, ears, and growing points
distribution_on_plant.horizontal_pattern: Long chlorotic stripes running parallel to leaf veins
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: Tassels (crazy top) and ears (malformed/sterile), whole plant stunting

pathognomonic_features: White, grey-white, or downy growth on the lower leaf surface of chlorotic stripes
Malformed tassels with leafy proliferation ('crazy top') and stunting with excessive tillering
